Chapter 17 - Standard Extensions
=================================

``stdext/`` supplies baseline assets for AutoComplete, AutoSyntax,
AutoCommand, and AutoPrompt. Source mapping is direct:

- ``stdext/AutoComplete`` -> ``$PIKORL_HOME/stdlib/AutoComplete``;
- ``stdext/AutoSyntax`` -> ``$PIKORL_HOME/stdlib/AutoSyntax``;
- ``stdext/AutoCommand`` -> ``$PIKORL_HOME/stdlib/AutoCommand``;
- ``stdext/AutoPrompt`` -> ``$PIKORL_HOME/stdlib/AutoPrompt``.

These assets establish defaults, not a replacement extension implementation.
